name: Newsletter Signup
summary: Email-capture section that composes Input and Button while leaving submission response ownership to the consuming target.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Title-labelled Newsletter section root omitted when required title or form composition is missing.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Native form composition containing Input and Button dependencies.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.description: Newsletter sizing hook composed onto the Input dependency's native email field.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned confirmed response hook; no neutral response state is implied.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Responsive form width supplied by canonical CSS.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting newsletter presentation; field states belong to the Input dependency.

behavior.name: inputComposition
behavior.description: The email field composes Input anatomy and must preserve Input's default, error, success, warning, hover, focus-visible, disabled, label, and message obligations.

behavior.name: formSubmission
behavior.description: The native form emits submission to the consuming target; this contract does not choose endpoint, pending, success, error, retry, replacement, redirect, or other response ownership.

behavior.name: responseBoundary
behavior.description: A target may render a truthful confirmed result using timing-appropriate semantics; the result is form-level and must not be repurposed as the Email field's validation message.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Native form content composed from Input and Button dependencies.

properties.name: note
properties.description: Optional privacy, consent, or message-frequency note.

accessibility: Render the signup as a native form and use a submit-capable Button dependency.
Compose the email control from Input with a visible label, native email semantics, stable submitted name, autocomplete, and required state when the target requires it.
Preserve Input's default, error, success, and warning validation families; use aria-invalid only for error.
Do not use placeholder text as the email field's only accessible name.
Keep form-level response feedback separate from field guidance and validation messages.
The consuming target must announce or navigate to a truthful submission result without this contract assuming where that response lives.

shopify.notes: Localized customer form uses canonical Input/Button markup, unique ids, platform field names, server error association, confirmed success, merchant content settings, and zero Newsletter JavaScript.
